correctness.rationale: The two published stage rules give the identical exact multiplier on scalar negative-real decay. The push-forward density is normalized and invertible; Leibniz differentiation, strict power-mean inequalities, dominated convergence/Fatou and uniform logarithmic moment bounds prove all finite-p thresholds and their ordering. Endpoint concentration proves the large-p constant; the uniform Taylor argument proves the small-p constant. The packaged checker independently verifies 272 rational/numerical identities; finite checks are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: The work resolves the natural all-positive-moment stability analysis explicitly proposed by the original algorithms paper, gives a complete necessary-and-sufficient sharp scalar step interval for every exponent, establishes a universal optimal step and strict nested moment boundaries, and quantifies singular low- and high-moment regimes. It distinguishes rare-event moment divergence from established almost-sure decay and is not merely the known p=2 calculation.
